```css
/* Health Bar */
.health-bar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    background: rgba(12,14,18,0.8);
    border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.health-item {
    font-size: 10px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: rgba(48,192,96,0.1);
    color: #70d070;
    border: 1px solid rgba(48,192,96,0.2);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.health-item.err {
    background: rgba(224,80,80,0.1);
    color: #e05050;
    border-color: rgba(224,80,80,0.2);
}

/* Dashboard Grid */
.dashboard-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.dash-card {
    background: rgba(12,14,18,0.9);
    border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    text-align: center;
}

.dash-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: #5a6a7a;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.dash-value {
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #e8f4ff;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.dash-unit {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #5a6a7a;
}

.dash-status {
    font-size: 11px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    display: inline-block;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.dash-status.ok {
    background: rgba(48,192,96,0.1);
    color: #70d070;
}

/* Control Panel */
.control-panel {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.control-left {
    background: rgba(12,14,18,0.9);
    border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 12px;
}

.control-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 4px 0;
}

.ctrl-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #8a9aa8;
    min-width: 30px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ctrl-bar {
    flex: 1;
    height: 6px;
    background: #16202a;
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.ctrl-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: #d4a040;
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.ctrl-value {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #e0eef8;
    min-width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* PID Display */
.control-right {
    background: rgba(12,14,18,0.9);
    border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 12px;
}

.pid-display {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2px 12px;
}

.pid-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 2px 0;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.pid-row.error {
    color: #e8b830;
}

.pid-row.output {
    border-top: 1px solid #1a1e24;
    margin-top: 4px;
    padding-top: 6px;
}

.pid-label {
    color: #6a7a8a;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.pid-value {
    color: #e0eef8;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.pid-unit {
    color: #5a6a7a;
    font-size: 10px;
    margin-left: 2px;
}

/* Rating */
.rating-panel {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 8px;
    background: rgba(12,14,18,0.9);
    border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.rating-stars {
    font-size: 24px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: #e8b830;
}

.rating-text {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #70d070;
}

.rating-detail {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #6a7a8a;
}

/* Energy Panel */
.energy-panel {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(12,14,18,0.9);
    border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.energy-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.energy-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #5a6a7a;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.energy-bar {
    height: 4px;
    background: #16202a;
    border-radius: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.energy-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: #d4a040;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

.energy-fill.loss {
    background: #e05050;
}

.energy-fill.reserve {
    background: #40b0d4;
}

.energy-value {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #e0eef8;
}

/* Quick Actions */
.quick-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: rgba(12,14,18,0.9);
    border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-top: 12px;
}

.quick-btn {
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border: 1px solid #2a3240;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: transparent;
    color: #8a9aa8;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
}

.quick-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border-color: #4a5a6a;
    color: #b0c8d8;
}

.quick-btn.danger {
    border-color: #6a3a3a;
    color: #c06060;
}

.quick-btn.danger:hover {
    background: rgba(224,80,80,0.1);
}

.quick-btn.primary {
    border-color: #3a6a5a;
    color: #5a9a8a;
}

.quick-btn.primary:hover {
    background: rgba(57,211,95,0.08);
}
```

## 🔧 JavaScript - aktualizacje różnicowe

```javascript
// Zamiast całego DOM, aktualizuj tylko zmienione elementy
function updateDashboard(data) {
    const elements = {
        temp: document.getElementById('tempValue'),
        rh: document.getElementById('rhValue'),
        day: document.getElementById('dayValue'),
        heater1: document.getElementById('heater1Fill'),
        heater2: document.getElementById('heater2Fill'),
        // ... itd
    };
    
    // Aktualizuj tylko jeśli wartość się zmieniła
    for (const [key, el] of Object.entries(elements)) {
        if (el && el.dataset.value !== String(data[key])) {
            el.textContent = data[key];
            el.dataset.value = data[key];
        }
    }
}
```

        .energy-bar {

            background: #16202a;

            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .energy-fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: #d4a040;
            border-radius: 3px;

            background: #e05050;
        }
        .energy-fill.reserve {
            background: #40b0d4;
        }
        .energy-value {
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #e0eef8;
        }

        .prediction-panel {
            display: grid;
            gap: 10px;
            background: rgba(12,14,18,0.95);
            border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 14px;
        }
        .prediction-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 10px;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #e0eef8;
        }
        .pred-label {
            color: #8a9aa8;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }
        .pred-value {
            color: #e8f4ff;
            font-weight: 800;
        }
        .pred-unit {
            color: #5a6a7a;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .rating-panel {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 14px;

            border: 1px solid #1a1e24;
            border-radius: 6px;

        .rating-stars {

        }
        .rating-text {

        .rating-detail {
            font-size: 12px;

            function updateStatusDashboard() {

                const rhDiff = rh !== null ? Math.abs(rh - rhTarget) : null;

                const rhStatusEl = document.getElementById('rhStatus');
                if (tempStatusEl) {
                    tempStatusEl.textContent = tempState === 'OK' ? 'OK' : tempState === 'WARN' ? 'WARN' : 'ALERT';

                }
                if (rhStatusEl) {
                    rhStatusEl.textContent = rhState === 'OK' ? 'OK' : rhState === 'WARN' ? 'WARN' : 'ALERT';
                    rhStatusEl.className = 'dash-status ' + (rhState === 'OK' ? 'ok' : rhState === 'WARN' ? 'warn' : 'err');
                }

                const heater0 = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((statusData.heater_pwm_ch0 ?? 0) / 4095 * 100)));
                const heater1 = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((statusData.heater_pwm_ch1 ?? 0) / 4095 * 100)));
                const fanPct = Number.isFinite(statusData.fan_speed) ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(statusData.fan_speed))) : (statusData.diffuser_0_on ? 100 : 0);
                const humPct = rh !== null ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((rh - 30) / 70 * 100))) : 0;

                setText('heater1Value', heater0 + '%');
                setText('heater2Value', heater1 + '%');
                document.getElementById('heater1Fill').style.width = heater0 + '%';
                document.getElementById('heater2Fill').style.width = heater1 + '%';
                setText('fanValue', fanPct + '%');
                document.getElementById('fanFill').style.width = fanPct + '%';
                setText('humValue', rh !== null ? humPct + '%' : 'OFF');
                document.getElementById('humFill').style.width = humPct + '%';

                setText('pidSet', setTemp.toFixed(2));
                setText('pidActual', temp !== null ? temp.toFixed(2) : '--');
                const errorVal = temp !== null ? temp - setTemp : 0;
                setText('pidError', temp !== null ? (errorVal >= 0 ? '+' : '') + errorVal.toFixed(2) : '--');
                setText('pidP', temp !== null ? (errorVal >= 0 ? '+' : '') + Math.round(errorVal * 12) : '--');
                setText('pidI', statusData.pid_i !== undefined ? (statusData.pid_i >= 0 ? '+' : '') + Math.round(statusData.pid_i) : '+8');
                setText('pidD', statusData.pid_d !== undefined ? (statusData.pid_d >= 0 ? '+' : '') + Math.round(statusData.pid_d) : '-2');
                const output = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round((heater0 + heater1) / 2)));
                setText('pidOutput', output + '%');

                const heatInput = heater0;

                setText('heatInputValue', heatInput + '%');
                setText('heatLossValue', heatLoss + '%');
                setText('reserveValue', reserve + '%');
                document.getElementById('heatInputFill').style.width = heatInput + '%';
                document.getElementById('heatLossFill').style.width = heatLoss + '%';
                document.getElementById('reserveFill').style.width = reserve + '%';

                const recent = history.slice(-2);
                let rate = 0;

                    const delta = recent[1].temp - recent[0].temp;
                    const dt = Math.max(1, (recent[1].timestamp - recent[0].timestamp) / 60000);
                    rate = delta / dt;
                }
                setText('heatingRateValue', (rate >= 0 ? '+' : '') + rate.toFixed(2));
                const prediction = temp !== null ? temp + rate * 3 : setTemp;
                setText('predictionValue', prediction.toFixed(2));

                const healthOk = tempState === 'OK' && rhState === 'OK' && statusData.esp_internal_temp < 65;

// common.js - nowa struktura

    },

        temperature: null,
        humidity: null,
        heater: { ch0: 0, ch1: 0 },
        fan: 0,
        alarm: { active: false, messages: [] },
        water: { level: 100, status: 'ok' },
        motor: { running: false, turns: 0 },
        rtc: { ok: true, time: null },
        wifi: { connected: false, rssi: 0 },
        sensors: { ds1: null, ds2: null, dht: null }
    },
    
    // Event Bus
    Events: {
        _listeners: {},
        emit(event, data) {
            if (this._listeners[event]) {
                this._listeners[event].forEach(cb => cb(data));
            }
        },
        subscribe(event, callback) {
            if (!this._listeners[event]) this._listeners[event] = [];
            this._listeners[event].push(callback);
        },
        unsubscribe(event, callback) {
            if (this._listeners[event]) {
                this._listeners[event] = this._listeners[event].filter(cb => cb !== callback);
            }
        }
    },
    
    // WebSocket

### 4. **Parser wiadomości**

```javascript
// common.js - Parser
Inkubator.Parser = {
    decode(message) {
        try {
            const data = JSON.parse(message);
            return this.normalize(data);
        } catch (e) {
            return this.parseLegacy(message);
        }
    },
    
    normalize(data) {
        return {
            type: data.type || 'update',
            payload: {
                temperature: data.temp_chamber ?? data.temp ?? null,
                humidity: data.humidity ?? null,
                heater: {
                    ch0: data.heater_pwm_ch0 ?? 0,
                    ch1: data.heater_pwm_ch1 ?? 0
                },
                fan: data.fan_speed ?? 0,
                motor: {
                    running: data.motor_running ?? false,
                    turns: data.motor_turns ?? 0
                },
                water: {
                    level: data.water_level ?? 100,
                    status: data.water_level < 20 ? 'low' : 'ok'
                },
                wifi: {
                    connected: data.wifi_connected ?? true,
                    rssi: data.wifi_rssi ?? -50
                },
                rtc: {
                    ok: data.rtc_ok ?? true,
                    time: data.rtc_time ?? null
                },
                sensors: {
                    ds1: data.temp_chamber ?? null,
                    ds2: data.temp_aquarium ?? null,
                    dht: data.humidity ?? null
                },
                esp: {
                    temp: data.esp_internal_temp ?? null,
                    free_ram: data.free_ram ?? null,
                    cpu: data.cpu_load ?? null
                }
            },
            timestamp: data.timestamp || Date.now()
        };
    },
    
    parseLegacy(message) {
        // Wsparcie dla starego formatu
        const data = {};
        message.split('\n').forEach(line => {
            const [key, value] = line.split('=');
            if (key && value) data[key.trim()] = parseFloat(value);
        });
        return this.normalize(data);
    }
};
```

```javascript
// common.js - tryb awaryjny
Inkubator.Offline = {
    _banner: null,
    _lastUpdate: null,
    _timer: null,
    
    show() {
        document.body.classList.add('offline');
        const banner = document.getElementById('offlineBanner');
        if (banner) {
            banner.classList.add('visible');
            banner.textContent = '⚠️ OFFLINE MODE - Last update: ' + 
                this._lastUpdate?.toLocaleTimeString() || 'never';
        }
        this._startCountdown();
    },
    
    hide() {
        document.body.classList.remove('offline');
        const banner = document.getElementById('offlineBanner');
        if (banner) banner.classList.remove('visible');
        clearInterval(this._timer);
    },
    
    _startCountdown() {
        clearInterval(this._timer);
        let seconds = 0;
        this._timer = setInterval(() => {
            seconds++;
            const banner = document.getElementById('offlineBanner');
            if (banner) {
                banner.textContent = `⚠️ OFFLINE MODE - ${seconds}s since last update`;
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
};
```

    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--status-ok);
    transition: all var(--transition-med);
}

.status-dot.online {
    animation: breathe 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    background: var(--status-ok);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--status-ok);
}

.status-dot.alarm {
    animation: pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
    background: var(--status-err);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--status-err);
}

.status-dot.offline {
    background: var(--text-muted);
    box-shadow: none;
}
```

### 7. **Event Bus w praktyce**

```javascript
// Przykład użycia Event Bus
// W common.js
Inkubator.Events.subscribe('status.update', (data) => {
    // Aktualizuj dashboard
    Inkubator.UI.updateMetric('temperature', data.temperature);
    Inkubator.UI.updateMetric('humidity', data.humidity);
    Inkubator.UI.updateHealth('wifi', data.wifi.connected);
});

// W dashboard.js
function updateDashboard(data) {
    // Emituj zdarzenie
    Inkubator.Events.emit('status.update', data);
}

// W log.js
Inkubator.Events.subscribe('status.update', (data) => {
    // Dodaj do logów tylko jeśli coś się zmieniło
    if (data.temperature !== lastTemp) {
        addLog('info', `Temp: ${data.temperature}°C`);
    }
});
```

## 📁 Nowa struktura plików

```
/web/
├── index.html              # Główny panel
├── common.js               # Biblioteka wspólna
├── style.css               # Style z zmiennymi
├── components/             # Komponenty HTML
│   ├── metric.html
│   ├── card.html
│   ├── progress.html
│   ├── health-item.html
│   └── badge.html
├── pages/                  # Strony
│   ├── dashboard.js
│   ├── diagnostics.js
│   ├── process.js
│   └── settings.js
├── icons/                  # Ikony SVG
│   ├── temp.svg
│   ├── humid.svg
│   ├── fan.svg
│   ├── motor.svg
│   ├── wifi.svg
│   └── alarm.svg
└── service-worker.js      # PWA (przyszłość)
```

## 🎯 Co daje ta architektura?

| Cecha | Korzyść |
|-------|---------|
| **Moduły logiczne** | Kod czytelny po roku |
| **CSS Variables** | Zmiana wyglądu w jednym miejscu |
| **Event Bus** | Luźne powiązania między komponentami |
| **Parser** | Format danych niezależny od źródła |
| **Offline Mode** | Użytkownik wie, że dane są opóźnione |
| **Komponenty** | Każda strona z tych samych klocków |
| **SVG Icons** | Skalowalne, czyste, bez emoji |

## 📊 Ocena końcowa

| Aspekt | Przed | Po |
|--------|-------|-----|
| Struktura | Spaghetti | Modułowa |
| Kolory | 10+ odcieni | 5 kolorów bazowych |
| Komponenty | Brak | Biblioteka |
| Event Bus | Callbacki | Emit/Subscribe |
| Offline | Brak | Pełne wsparcie |
| Animacje | Brak | Subtelne, użyteczne |
| Rozwijalność | Trudna | Łatwa |

To jest **fundament prawdziwego HMI frameworka** dla ESP32-S3. Teraz każda nowa strona to tylko składanie gotowych komponentów i podłączanie się do Event Bus. 🚀

**Input:**

- content:

```
/**
 * common.js - modular shared runtime for Inkubator HMI
 */
(function() {
    'use strict';

    const Inkubator = {
        Config: {
            wsPort: 81,
            wsReconnect: 3000,
            maxRetries: 10,
            debug: false,
            apiTimeoutMs: 5000
        },

        State: {
            temperature: null,
            humidity: null,
            heater: { ch0: 0, ch1: 0 },
            fan: 0,
            alarm: { active: false, messages: [] },
            water: { level: 100, status: 'ok' },
            motor: { running: false, turns: 0 },
            rtc: { ok: true, time: null },
            wifi: { connected: false, rssi: 0 },
            sensors: { ds1: null, ds2: null, dht: null },
            esp: { temp: null, free_ram: null, cpu: null },
            lastUpdateTs: null,
            offline: false
        },

        Events: {
            _listeners: {},
            emit: function(event, data) {
                const listeners = this._listeners[event];
                if (!listeners || !listeners.length) return;
                listeners.forEach(function(cb) {
                    try {
                        cb(data);
                    } catch (err) {
                        if (Inkubator.Config.debug) {
                            console.warn('Event listener failed for', event, err);
                        }
                    }
                });
            },
            subscribe: function(event, callback) {
                if (!this._listeners[event]) this._listeners[event] = [];
                this._listeners[event].push(callback);
                return () => this.unsubscribe(event, callback);
            },
            unsubscribe: function(event, callback) {
                if (!this._listeners[event]) return;
                this._listeners[event] = this._listeners[event].filter(function(cb) {
                    return cb !== callback;
                });
            }
        },

        Parser: {
            decode: function(message) {
                if (typeof message !== 'string') {
                    return this.normalize(message || {});
                }
                try {
                    return this.normalize(JSON.parse(message));
                } catch (err) {
                    return this.parseLegacy(message);
                }
            },

            normalize: function(data) {
                const normalized = {
                    type: data.type || 'update',
                    payload: {
                        temperature: data.temp_chamber ?? data.temp ?? null,
                        humidity: data.humidity ?? null,
                        heater: {
                            ch0: data.heater_pwm_ch0 ?? 0,
                            ch1: data.heater_pwm_ch1 ?? 0
                        },
                        fan: data.fan_speed ?? 0,
                        motor: {
                            running: data.motor_running ?? false,
                            turns: data.motor_turns ?? 0
                        },
                        water: {
                            level: data.water_level ?? 100,
                            status: (data.water_level ?? 100) < 20 ? 'low' : 'ok'
                        },
                        wifi: {
                            connected: data.wifi_connected ?? true,
                            rssi: data.wifi_rssi ?? -50
                        },
                        rtc: {
                            ok: data.rtc_ok ?? true,
                            time: data.rtc_time ?? null
                        },
                        sensors: {
                            ds1: data.temp_chamber ?? null,
                            ds2: data.temp_aquarium ?? null,
                            dht: data.humidity ?? null
                        },
                        esp: {
                            temp: data.esp_internal_temp ?? null,
                            free_ram: data.free_ram ?? null,
                            cpu: data.cpu_load ?? null
                        },
                        raw: data
                    },
                    timestamp: data.timestamp || Date.now()
                };
                return normalized;
            },

            parseLegacy: function(message) {
                const parsed = {};
                message.split('\n').forEach(function(line) {
                    const pair = line.split('=');
                    if (pair.length < 2) return;
                    const key = pair[0].trim();
                    const raw = pair.slice(1).join('=').trim();
                    const num = Number(raw);
                    parsed[key] = Number.isFinite(num) ? num : raw;
                });
                return this.normalize(parsed);
            }
        },

        WS: {
            _ws: null,
            _reconnectTimer: null,
            _retryCount: 0,

            getUrl: function(path) {
                const wsPath = path || '/';
                const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
                const host = window.location.hostname || window.location.host;
                return protocol + '//' + host + ':' + Inkubator.Config.wsPort + wsPath;
            },

            connect: function(path) {
                if (this._ws && (this._ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN || this._ws.readyState === WebSocket.CONNECTING)) {
                    return this._ws;
                }

                const self = this;
                Inkubator.UI.setConnectionState('connecting');

                try {
                    this._ws = new WebSocket(this.getUrl(path));
                } catch (err) {
                    this._scheduleReconnect(path);
                    Inkubator.Events.emit('ws.error', { error: err });
                    return null;
                }

                this._ws.onopen = function() {
                    self._retryCount = 0;
                    Inkubator.UI.setConnectionState('connected');
                    Inkubator.Offline.hide();
                    Inkubator.Events.emit('ws.open', { ws: self._ws });
                };

                this._ws.onmessage = function(event) {
                    const parsed = Inkubator.Parser.decode(event.data);
                    Inkubator.Events.emit('ws.message', { raw: event.data, parsed: parsed });
                    Inkubator.Events.emit('status.update', parsed.payload);
                    Inkubator.setStateFromPayload(parsed.payload, parsed.timestamp);
                };

                this._ws.onclose = function() {
                    Inkubator.UI.setConnectionState('disconnected');
                    Inkubator.Events.emit('ws.close', {});
                    self._scheduleReconnect(path);
                };

                this._ws.onerror = function(error) {
                    Inkubator.Events.emit('ws.error', { error: error });
                };

                return this._ws;
            },

            send: function(command, data) {
                if (!this._ws || this._ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    Inkubator.UI.setStatus('Brak polaczenia z ESP', 'err');
                    return false;
                }

                const payload = data ? { command: command, data: data } : command;
                this._ws.send(typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload));
                Inkubator.Events.emit('ws.send', payload);
                return true;
            },

            _scheduleReconnect: function(path) {
                clearTimeout(this._reconnectTimer);
                this._retryCount += 1;
                if (this._retryCount > Inkubator.Config.maxRetries) {
                    Inkubator.UI.setStatus('Przekroczono limit ponownych polaczen', 'err');
                    Inkubator.Offline.show();
                    return;
                }
                const waitMs = Math.min(10000, Inkubator.Config.wsReconnect * this._retryCount);
                this._reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => this.connect(path), waitMs);
                Inkubator.Offline.show();
            }
        },

        API: {
            fetchJson: function(url, options) {
                const cfg = options || {};
                const controller = new AbortController();
                const timer = setTimeout(function() {
                    controller.abort();
                }, Inkubator.Config.apiTimeoutMs);

                return fetch(url, { ...cfg, signal: controller.signal })
                    .then(function(resp) {
                        clearTimeout(timer);
                        return resp.json();
                    });
            },

            fetchStatus: function() {
                return this.fetchJson('/api/status');
            },

            fetchTrays: function() {
                return this.fetchJson('/api/trays');
            },

            sendCommand: function(command, data) {
                return this.fetchJson('/api/command', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ command: command, data: data || {} })
                });
            }
        },

        UI: {
            updateMetric: function(id, value, unit) {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (!el) return;
                const text = unit ? String(value) + ' ' + unit : String(value);
                if (el.dataset.value !== text) {
                    el.textContent = text;
                    el.dataset.value = text;
                }
            },

            updateBadge: function(id, status) {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (!el) return;
                const cls = status === 'ok' ? 'ok' : status === 'warn' ? 'warn' : status === 'err' ? 'err' : '';
                el.classList.remove('ok', 'warn', 'err');
                if (cls) el.classList.add(cls);
            },

            updateHealth: function(id, ok) {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (!el) return;
                el.classList.remove('ok', 'err');
                el.classList.add(ok ? 'ok' : 'err');
            },

            showToast: function(message, type) {
                const toast = document.createElement('div');
                toast.className = 'hmi-toast ' + (type || 'info');
                toast.textContent = message;
                document.body.appendChild(toast);
                setTimeout(function() {
                    toast.classList.add('show');
                }, 10);
                setTimeout(function() {
                    toast.classList.remove('show');
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        toast.remove();
                    }, 200);
                }, 2200);
            },

            setStatus: function(text, type) {
                const statusMsg = document.getElementById('statusMsg');
                if (!statusMsg) return;
                statusMsg.textContent = text;
                statusMsg.className = 'msg' + (type ? ' ' + type : '');
            },

            setConnectionState: function(state) {
                const wsDot = document.getElementById('wsDot');
                const wsStatus = document.getElementById('wsStatus');
                const wsDetail = document.getElementById('wsDetail');

                if (wsDot) {
                    wsDot.classList.remove('online', 'offline', 'warn');
                    if (state === 'connected') wsDot.classList.add('online');
                    if (state === 'disconnected') wsDot.classList.add('offline');
                    if (state === 'connecting') wsDot.classList.add('warn');
                }

                if (wsStatus) {
                    wsStatus.textContent = state === 'connected' ? 'Polaczono' : state === 'connecting' ? 'Laczenie' : 'Rozlaczono';
                }

                if (wsDetail) {
                    wsDetail.textContent = state === 'connected' ? 'WebSocket OK' : 'WebSocket ' + state;
                }
            }
        },

        Storage: {
            save: function(key, data) {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(data));
                    return true;
                } catch (err) {
                    return false;
                }
            },
            load: function(key, fallback) {
                try {
                    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
                    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : fallback;
                } catch (err) {
                    return fallback;
                }
            },
            clear: function() {
                try {
                    localStorage.clear();
                    return true;
                } catch (err) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        },

        Utils: {
            formatTime: function(ms) {
                const totalSec = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000));
                const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
                const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
                const s = totalSec % 60;
                if (h > 0) return String(h).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
                return String(m).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(s).padStart(2, '0');
            },
            clamp: function(value, min, max) {
                return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
            },
            round: function(value, decimals) {
                const p = Math.pow(10, decimals || 0);
                return Math.round(value * p) / p;
            },
            parseFloatSafe: function(value, fallback) {
                const parsed = parseFloat(value);
                return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : fallback;
            },
            parseIntSafe: function(value, fallback) {
                const parsed = parseInt(value, 10);
                return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : fallback;
            }
        },

        Offline: {
            _timer: null,
            _lastUpdate: null,
            show: function() {
                const instrument = document.querySelector('.instrument');
                const banner = document.getElementById('offlineBanner');
                if (instrument) instrument.classList.add('offline');
                if (banner) {
                    banner.classList.add('visible');
                    const stamp = this._lastUpdate ? this._lastUpdate.toLocaleTimeString() : 'never';
                    banner.textContent = 'OFFLINE MODE - last update: ' + stamp;
                }
                this._startCountdown();
            },
            hide: function() {
                const instrument = document.querySelector('.instrument');
                const banner = document.getElementById('offlineBanner');
                if (instrument) instrument.classList.remove('offline');
                if (banner) banner.classList.remove('visible');
                clearInterval(this._timer);
                this._timer = null;
            },
            markUpdate: function(timestamp) {
                this._lastUpdate = timestamp ? new Date(timestamp) : new Date();
            },
            _startCountdown: function() {
                clearInterval(this._timer);
                let seconds = 0;
                this._timer = setInterval(function() {
                    seconds += 1;
                    const banner = document.getElementById('offlineBanner');
                    if (banner) {
                        banner.textContent = 'OFFLINE MODE - ' + seconds + 's since last update';
                    }
                }, 1000);
            }
        },

        setStateFromPayload: function(payload, timestamp) {
            if (!payload) return;
            this.State.temperature = payload.temperature;
            this.State.humidity = payload.humidity;
            this.State.heater = payload.heater || this.State.heater;
            this.State.fan = payload.fan ?? this.State.fan;
            this.State.motor = payload.motor || this.State.motor;
            this.State.water = payload.water || this.State.water;
            this.State.wifi = payload.wifi || this.State.wifi;
            this.State.rtc = payload.rtc || this.State.rtc;
            this.State.sensors = payload.sensors || this.State.sensors;
            this.State.esp = payload.esp || this.State.esp;
            this.State.lastUpdateTs = timestamp || Date.now();
            this.State.offline = false;
            this.Offline.markUpdate(this.State.lastUpdateTs);
            this.Offline.hide();
        }
    };

    Inkubator.wsSend = function(command, data) { return Inkubator.WS.send(command, data); };
    Inkubator.wsConnect = function(path) { return Inkubator.WS.connect(path); };
    Inkubator.wsConnected = function() {
        return Inkubator.WS._ws && Inkubator.WS._ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN;
    };
    Inkubator.setStatus = Inkubator.UI.setStatus;
    Inkubator.setWsStatus = Inkubator.UI.setConnectionState;
    Inkubator.reconnectManually = function(path) {
        if (Inkubator.WS._ws) {
            try { Inkubator.WS._ws.close(); } catch (err) {}
        }
        Inkubator.WS._retryCount = 0;
        Inkubator.WS.connect(path || '/');
    };
    Inkubator.onWsEvent = function(callback) {
        if (typeof callback !== 'function') return function() {};

        const unsubOpen = Inkubator.Events.subscribe('ws.open', function(event) {
            callback('open', event.ws);
        });
        const unsubMsg = Inkubator.Events.subscribe('ws.message', function(event) {
            callback('message', Inkubator.WS._ws, event.raw);
        });
        const unsubClose = Inkubator.Events.subscribe('ws.close', function() {
            callback('close', Inkubator.WS._ws);
        });

        return function() {
            unsubOpen();
            unsubMsg();
            unsubClose();
        };
    };
    Inkubator.parseFloatSafe = Inkubator.Utils.parseFloatSafe;
    Inkubator.parseIntSafe = Inkubator.Utils.parseIntSafe;
    Inkubator.clamp = Inkubator.Utils.clamp;
    Inkubator.getWsUrl = Inkubator.WS.getUrl.bind(Inkubator.WS);

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const wsStatus = document.getElementById('wsStatus');
        const wsDot = document.getElementById('wsDot');

        if (wsStatus) wsStatus.addEventListener('click', function() { Inkubator.reconnectManually('/'); });
        if (wsDot) wsDot.addEventListener('click', function() { Inkubator.reconnectManually('/'); });

        Inkubator.WS.connect('/');

        setInterval(function() {
            if (!Inkubator.wsConnected()) {
                Inkubator.reconnectManually('/');
            }
        }, 30000);
    });

    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function() {
        clearTimeout(Inkubator.WS._reconnectTimer);
        if (Inkubator.WS._ws) {
            try { Inkubator.WS._ws.close(); } catch (err) {}
        }
    });

    window.Inkubator = Inkubator;
})();

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (!window.Inkubator) return;

    Inkubator.Events.subscribe('status.update', function(data) {
        const heater = data.heater || { ch0: 0, ch1: 0 };
        const avg = Math.round((Number(heater.ch0 || 0) + Number(heater.ch1 || 0)) / 2);
        const phase = avg > 1200 ? 'Heating' : avg > 400 ? 'Stabilizing' : 'Idle';
        const phaseEl = document.getElementById('procPhase');
        if (phaseEl) phaseEl.textContent = phase;
    });
});

+

<summary>Tool use: **run_in_terminal**</summary>

**Input:**

- command:

```
$files = Get-ChildItem 'J:\inkubator\inkubator-new\firmware\data' -Filter *.html | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'index.html' }
$metaDesc = '    <meta name="description" content="Panel sterowania inkubatorem: konfiguracja, diagnostyka i monitoring." />'
$metaTheme = '    <meta name="theme-color" content="#101317" />'
$bodyBlock = @'
<body>

    <noscript><div class="noscript-banner">Do poprawnego działania panelu wymagany jest JavaScript.</div></noscript>
    <div id="offlineBanner" class="offline-banner" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>
'@

foreach ($f in $files) {
    $t = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $f.FullName

    if ($t -notmatch '<meta name="description"') {
        $t = [regex]::Replace($t, '(<meta name="viewport"[^>]*>\s*)', ('$1' + "`n" + $metaDesc + "`n" + $metaTheme + "`n"), 1)
    }

    if ($t -notmatch '<body>') {
        $t = $t -replace '</head>\s*', "</head>`n" + $bodyBlock
    }

    if ($t -notmatch '<noscript><div class="noscript-banner">') {
        $t = $t -replace '<body>\s*', $bodyBlock
    }

    $t = $t -replace '<div class="instrument">', '<main class="instrument" id="mainContent" role="main">'
    $t = $t -replace '<div class="status-bar">', '<div class="status-bar" role="status" aria-live="polite">'

    if ($t -notmatch '</main>') {
        $t = $t -replace '</div>\s*(<!-- ===== SKRYPTY ===== -->)', "</main>`n`n    `$1"
        $t = $t -replace '</div>\s*</body>', "</main>`n`n</body>"
    }

    Set-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Value $t -Encoding UTF8
}

```

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="create_file"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **create_file**</summary>

**Input:**

- content:

```
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path 'J:\inkubator\inkubator-new\firmware\data' -Filter *.html | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne 'index.html' }

$metaDescLine = '    <meta name="description" content="Panel sterowania inkubatorem: konfiguracja, diagnostyka i monitoring." />'
$metaThemeLine = '    <meta name="theme-color" content="#101317" />'
$bodyBlock = @"
<body>

    <noscript><div class="noscript-banner">Do poprawnego dzialania panelu wymagany jest JavaScript.</div></noscript>
    <div id="offlineBanner" class="offline-banner" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>
"@

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $text = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $file.FullName

    if ($text -notmatch '<meta name="description"') {
        $text = [regex]::Replace(
            $text,
            '(<meta name="viewport"[^>]*>\s*)',
            "$1`n$metaDescLine`n$metaThemeLine`n",
            1
        )
    }

    $text = $text -replace '<div class="instrument">', '<main class="instrument" id="mainContent" role="main">'
    $text = $text -replace '<div class="status-bar">', '<div class="status-bar" role="status" aria-live="polite">'

    if ($text -notmatch '<body>') {
        $text = [regex]::Replace($text, '</head>\s*', "</head>`n$bodyBlock", 1)
    }

    if ($text -notmatch '<noscript><div class="noscript-banner">') {
        $text = [regex]::Replace($text, '<body>\s*', $bodyBlock, 1)
    }

    if ($text -notmatch '</main>') {
        $text = [regex]::Replace($text, '</div>\s*(<!-- ===== SKRYPTY ===== -->)', "</main>`n`n    $1", 1)
        $text = [regex]::Replace($text, '</div>\s*</body>', "</main>`n`n</body>", 1)
    }

    Set-Content -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Value $text -Encoding UTF8
}

```

(function() {
    'use strict';

    const ink = window.Inkubator;
    if (!ink) {
        console.error('[symulacja_legow.js] Brak wspolnego modulu Inkubator');
        return;
    }

    const STORAGE_KEY = 'inkubator.simLegow.v1';

    const PROFILES = {
        chicken: {
            common_name: 'Kura',
            incubation_days: 21,
            day_by_day: Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, i) => {
                const d = i + 1;
                const isLockdown = d >= 19;
                return {
                    day: d,
                    shell_temp: isLockdown ? 37.5 : 37.7 + (d > 13 ? Math.min((d - 13) * 0.1, 0.7) : 0),
                    humidity_set: isLockdown ? 72 : 50,
                    humidity_range: isLockdown ? [65, 80] : [40, 60],
                    turning: !isLockdown,
                    sensitivity: d <= 3 ? 'CRITICAL' : (d <= 5 || isLockdown ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM')
                };
            })
        },
        duck_indian_runner: {
            common_name: 'Kaczka Biegus',
            incubation_days: 28,
            day_by_day: Array.from({ length: 28 }, (_, i) => {
                const d = i + 1;
                const isLockdown = d >= 25;
                return {
                    day: d,
                    shell_temp: isLockdown ? 37.5 : 37.7 + (d > 12 ? Math.min((d - 12) * 0.06, 0.7) : 0),
                    humidity_set: isLockdown ? 68 : 55,
                    humidity_range: isLockdown ? [65, 75] : [50, 62],
                    turning: !isLockdown,
                    sensitivity: d <= 3 ? 'CRITICAL' : (d <= 5 || isLockdown ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM')
                };
            })
        },
        goose: {
            common_name: 'Ges',
            incubation_days: 30,
            day_by_day: Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => {
                const d = i + 1;
                const isLockdown = d >= 27;
                return {
                    day: d,
                    shell_temp: isLockdown ? 37.5 : 37.7 + (d > 12 ? Math.min((d - 12) * 0.06, 0.7) : 0),
                    humidity_set: isLockdown ? 68 : 55,
                    humidity_range: isLockdown ? [65, 75] : [50, 62],
                    turning: !isLockdown,
                    sensitivity: d <= 3 ? 'CRITICAL' : (d <= 5 || isLockdown ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM')
                };
            })
        },
        quail: {
            common_name: 'Przepiorka',
            incubation_days: 17,
            day_by_day: Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => {
                const d = i + 1;
                const isLockdown = d >= 15;
                return {
                    day: d,
                    shell_temp: isLockdown ? 37.5 : 37.7 + (d > 8 ? Math.min((d - 8) * 0.08, 0.6) : 0),
                    humidity_set: isLockdown ? 65 : 50,
                    humidity_range: isLockdown ? [60, 75] : [45, 60],
                    turning: !isLockdown,
                    sensitivity: d <= 3 ? 'CRITICAL' : (d <= 5 || isLockdown ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM')
                };
            })
        }
    };

    const SENSITIVITY_COLORS = {
        CRITICAL: '#e05050',
        HIGH: '#e8b830',
        MEDIUM: '#70d070'
    };

    const SENSITIVITY_LABELS = {
        CRITICAL: 'KRYTYCZNA',
        HIGH: 'WRAZLIWA',
        MEDIUM: 'NORMALNA'
    };

    const SCENARIOS = {
        normal: { temp: 0, hum: 0 },
        heat_stress: { temp: 0.6, hum: -6 },
        cold_stress: { temp: -0.6, hum: 4 },
        dry: { temp: 0.1, hum: -10 },
        wet: { temp: -0.1, hum: 10 }
    };

    const species1 = document.getElementById('species1');
    const species2 = document.getElementById('species2');
    const offset1 = document.getElementById('offset1');
    const offset2 = document.getElementById('offset2');
    const daySlider = document.getElementById('daySlider');
    const dayDisplay = document.getElementById('dayDisplay');

    const tempCanvas = document.getElementById('tempChart');
    const humCanvas = document.getElementById('humChart');
    const tempLegend = document.getElementById('tempLegend');
    const humLegend = document.getElementById('humLegend');

    const updateBtn = document.getElementById('updateBtn');
    const exportBtn = document.getElementById('exportBtn');
    const resetBtn = document.getElementById('resetBtn');
    const backBtn = document.getElementById('backBtn');
    const playBtn = document.getElementById('playBtn');

    const scenarioSelect = document.getElementById('scenarioSelect');
    const noiseLevel = document.getElementById('noiseLevel');
    const noiseLevelVal = document.getElementById('noiseLevelVal');
    const tempBias = document.getElementById('tempBias');
    const tempBiasVal = document.getElementById('tempBiasVal');
    const humBias = document.getElementById('humBias');
    const humBiasVal = document.getElementById('humBiasVal');

    let currentDay = 10;
    let sim1 = { species: 'chicken', offset: 0, profile: PROFILES.chicken };
    let sim2 = { species: 'duck_indian_runner', offset: 5, profile: PROFILES.duck_indian_runner };

    const simConfig = {
        scenario: 'normal',
        noise: 0.15,
        tempBias: 0,
        humBias: 0,
        autoRun: false
    };

    let autoTimer = null;

    function clamp(value, min, max) {
        return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value));
    }

    function getProfile(speciesId) {
        return PROFILES[speciesId] || PROFILES.chicken;
    }

    function getDayData(profile, day) {
        if (!profile || !profile.day_by_day) return null;
        return profile.day_by_day.find(d => d.day === day) || null;
    }

    function getTolerance(sensitivity, metric) {
        const tol = {
            temp: { CRITICAL: 0.3, HIGH: 0.6, MEDIUM: 1.0 },
            humidity: { CRITICAL: 3, HIGH: 5, MEDIUM: 8 }
        };
        return tol[metric]?.[sensitivity] || (metric === 'temp' ? 1.0 : 8);
    }

    function pseudoNoise(day, seed) {
        const x = Math.sin((day * 12.9898) + (seed * 78.233)) * 43758.5453;
        return (x - Math.floor(x)) * 2 - 1;
    }

    function getScenarioOffsets() {
        return SCENARIOS[simConfig.scenario] || SCENARIOS.normal;
    }

    function getEffectiveDayData(sim, targetDay) {
        const profile = sim.profile;
        const totalDays = profile.incubation_days;
        const clampedDay = clamp(targetDay, 1, totalDays);
        const base = getDayData(profile, clampedDay);
        if (!base) return null;

        const scenario = getScenarioOffsets();
        const noiseAmpTemp = simConfig.noise;
        const noiseAmpHum = simConfig.noise * 8;
        const noiseT = pseudoNoise(clampedDay, sim.offset + (sim.species === 'chicken' ? 1 : 2));
        const noiseH = pseudoNoise(clampedDay, sim.offset + (sim.species === 'goose' ? 7 : 11));

        const simulatedTemp = clamp(
            base.shell_temp + scenario.temp + simConfig.tempBias + (noiseT * noiseAmpTemp),
            35.0,
            40.5
        );
        const simulatedHum = clamp(
            base.humidity_set + scenario.hum + simConfig.humBias + (noiseH * noiseAmpHum),
            20,
            95
        );

        const lower = clamp(simulatedHum - getTolerance(base.sensitivity, 'humidity'), 20, 95);
        const upper = clamp(simulatedHum + getTolerance(base.sensitivity, 'humidity'), 20, 95);

        return {
            ...base,
            shell_temp: simulatedTemp,
            humidity_set: Math.round(simulatedHum),
            humidity_range: [Math.round(lower), Math.round(upper)]
        };
    }

    function setScenarioValueLabels() {
        noiseLevelVal.textContent = Number(simConfig.noise).toFixed(2);
        tempBiasVal.textContent = Number(simConfig.tempBias).toFixed(1) + ' C';
        humBiasVal.textContent = Number(simConfig.humBias).toFixed(0) + ' %';
    }

    function syncControlsFromState() {
        species1.value = sim1.species;
        species2.value = sim2.species;
        offset1.value = sim1.offset;
        offset2.value = sim2.offset;
        daySlider.value = currentDay;
        dayDisplay.textContent = currentDay;

        scenarioSelect.value = simConfig.scenario;
        noiseLevel.value = simConfig.noise;
        tempBias.value = simConfig.tempBias;
        humBias.value = simConfig.humBias;
        setScenarioValueLabels();

        playBtn.textContent = simConfig.autoRun ? 'Auto-run ON' : 'Auto-run OFF';
    }

    function persistConfig() {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                currentDay,
                sim1Species: sim1.species,
                sim1Offset: sim1.offset,
                sim2Species: sim2.species,
                sim2Offset: sim2.offset,
                scenario: simConfig.scenario,
                noise: simConfig.noise,
                tempBias: simConfig.tempBias,
                humBias: simConfig.humBias,
                autoRun: simConfig.autoRun
            }));
        } catch (err) {
            console.warn('[symulacja_legow.js] localStorage save failed', err);
        }
    }

    function loadConfig() {
        try {
            const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
            if (!raw) return;
            const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);

            currentDay = clamp(Number(parsed.currentDay) || currentDay, 1, 30);
            sim1.species = parsed.sim1Species || sim1.species;
            sim2.species = parsed.sim2Species || sim2.species;
            sim1.offset = clamp(Number(parsed.sim1Offset) || 0, 0, 10);
            sim2.offset = clamp(Number(parsed.sim2Offset) || 0, 0, 10);
            sim1.profile = getProfile(sim1.species);
            sim2.profile = getProfile(sim2.species);

            simConfig.scenario = parsed.scenario && SCENARIOS[parsed.scenario] ? parsed.scenario : 'normal';
            simConfig.noise = clamp(Number(parsed.noise), 0, 0.8);
            simConfig.tempBias = clamp(Number(parsed.tempBias), -1.5, 1.5);
            simConfig.humBias = clamp(Number(parsed.humBias), -15, 15);
            simConfig.autoRun = Boolean(parsed.autoRun);

            if (!Number.isFinite(simConfig.noise)) simConfig.noise = 0.15;
            if (!Number.isFinite(simConfig.tempBias)) simConfig.tempBias = 0;
            if (!Number.isFinite(simConfig.humBias)) simConfig.humBias = 0;
        } catch (err) {
            console.warn('[symulacja_legow.js] localStorage load failed', err);
        }
    }

    function updateInfoCards() {
        updateInfoCard(1);
        updateInfoCard(2);
    }

    function updateInfoCard(n) {
        const sim = n === 1 ? sim1 : sim2;
        const profile = sim.profile;
        const displayDay = currentDay - sim.offset;
        const clampedDay = clamp(displayDay, 1, profile.incubation_days);

        const prefix = 'info' + n;
        document.getElementById(prefix + 'Name').textContent = profile.common_name;
        document.getElementById(prefix + 'Day').textContent = displayDay + '/' + profile.incubation_days;

        const dayData = getEffectiveDayData(sim, clampedDay);
        if (!dayData) {
            document.getElementById(prefix + 'Temp').textContent = '-- C';
            document.getElementById(prefix + 'TempRange').textContent = '--';
            document.getElementById(prefix + 'Hum').textContent = '-- %';
            document.getElementById(prefix + 'HumRange').textContent = '--';
            document.getElementById(prefix + 'Sens').textContent = '--';
            document.getElementById(prefix + 'Turn').textContent = '--';
            return;
        }

        const tempTol = getTolerance(dayData.sensitivity, 'temp');
        const sensColor = SENSITIVITY_COLORS[dayData.sensitivity] || '#70d070';
        const sensLabel = SENSITIVITY_LABELS[dayData.sensitivity] || 'NORMALNA';

        document.getElementById(prefix + 'Temp').textContent = dayData.shell_temp.toFixed(2) + ' C';
        document.getElementById(prefix + 'TempRange').textContent = '+/- ' + tempTol.toFixed(1) + ' C';
        document.getElementById(prefix + 'Hum').textContent = dayData.humidity_set + ' %';
        document.getElementById(prefix + 'HumRange').textContent = dayData.humidity_range.join('-') + ' %';
        document.getElementById(prefix + 'Sens').innerHTML = '<span style="color:' + sensColor + ';">' + sensLabel + '</span>';
        document.getElementById(prefix + 'Turn').textContent = dayData.turning ? 'TAK' : 'NIE';

        const alarmEl = document.getElementById('alarm' + n);
        const isLockdown = !dayData.turning;
        if (isLockdown) {
            alarmEl.textContent = 'LOCKDOWN - nie otwieraj komory bez potrzeby';
            alarmEl.className = 'alarm-box warning';
        } else if (dayData.sensitivity === 'CRITICAL') {
            alarmEl.textContent = 'Faza krytyczna - trzymaj stabilne warunki';
            alarmEl.className = 'alarm-box warning';
        } else {
            alarmEl.textContent = 'Warunki stabilne';
            alarmEl.className = 'alarm-box ok';
        }
    }

    function updateComparison() {
        const day1 = clamp(currentDay - sim1.offset, 1, sim1.profile.incubation_days);
        const day2 = clamp(currentDay - sim2.offset, 1, sim2.profile.incubation_days);
        const d1 = getEffectiveDayData(sim1, day1);
        const d2 = getEffectiveDayData(sim2, day2);

        if (!d1 || !d2) {
            document.getElementById('compTemp').textContent = '-- C do -- C';
            document.getElementById('compHum').textContent = '--% do --%';
            document.getElementById('compStatus').textContent = 'Brak danych';
            document.getElementById('compDesc').textContent = 'Brak danych do porownania.';
            return;
        }

        const tMin = Math.max(
            d1.shell_temp - getTolerance(d1.sensitivity, 'temp'),
            d2.shell_temp - getTolerance(d2.sensitivity, 'temp')
        );
        const tMax = Math.min(
            d1.shell_temp + getTolerance(d1.sensitivity, 'temp'),
            d2.shell_temp + getTolerance(d2.sensitivity, 'temp')
        );

        const hMin = Math.max(
            d1.humidity_set - getTolerance(d1.sensitivity, 'humidity'),
            d2.humidity_set - getTolerance(d2.sensitivity, 'humidity')
        );
        const hMax = Math.min(
            d1.humidity_set + getTolerance(d1.sensitivity, 'humidity'),
            d2.humidity_set + getTolerance(d2.sensitivity, 'humidity')
        );

        const tempOk = tMin <= tMax;
        const humOk = hMin <= hMax;
        const compatible = tempOk && humOk;

        document.getElementById('compTemp').textContent = (tempOk ? tMin.toFixed(1) + ' do ' + tMax.toFixed(1) : 'BRAK') + ' C';
        document.getElementById('compHum').textContent = (humOk ? hMin.toFixed(0) + ' do ' + hMax.toFixed(0) : 'BRAK') + ' %';
        document.getElementById('compStatus').innerHTML = compatible ?
            '<span style="color:#70d070;">KOMPATYBILNE</span>' :
            '<span style="color:#e05050;">KONFLIKT</span>';
        document.getElementById('compDesc').textContent = compatible ?
            'Zakresy wspolne sa poprawne. Mozliwa koinkubacja.' :
            'Zakresy warunkow sie rozjezdzaja. Rozwaz osobne cykle.';
    }

    function drawCharts() {
        drawChart(tempCanvas, 'temp');
        drawChart(humCanvas, 'humidity');
    }

    function drawChart(canvas, metric) {
        if (!canvas) return;

        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const w = rect.width || 400;
        const h = rect.height || 200;

        canvas.width = w * 2;
        canvas.height = h * 2;
        canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
        ctx.scale(2, 2);

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

        const pad = { top: 16, right: 16, bottom: 24, left: 32 };
        const plotW = w - pad.left - pad.right;
        const plotH = h - pad.top - pad.bottom;

        const maxD = Math.max(sim1.profile.incubation_days + sim1.offset, sim2.profile.incubation_days + sim2.offset);
        const minD = 1;
        const mapX = day => pad.left + ((day - minD) / Math.max(1, maxD - minD)) * plotW;

        const minVal = metric === 'temp' ? 35.5 : 25;
        const maxVal = metric === 'temp' ? 40.5 : 90;
        const mapY = val => pad.top + plotH - ((val - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)) * plotH;

        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,14,18,0.5)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(26,30,36,0.3)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
        const step = metric === 'temp' ? 0.5 : 10;
        for (let i = minVal; i <= maxVal; i += step) {
            const y = mapY(i);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(pad.left, y);
            ctx.lineTo(w - pad.right, y);
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#2a3240';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(pad.left, pad.top);
        ctx.lineTo(pad.left, h - pad.bottom);
        ctx.lineTo(w - pad.right, h - pad.bottom);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a6a7a';
        ctx.font = '8px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        for (let i = minVal; i <= maxVal; i += step * 2) {
            ctx.fillText(i.toFixed(metric === 'temp' ? 1 : 0), pad.left - 4, mapY(i));
        }

        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
        const xStep = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxD / 10));
        for (let d = 1; d <= maxD; d += xStep) {
            ctx.fillText(String(d), mapX(d), h - pad.bottom + 4);
        }

        const sims = [sim1, sim2];
        const colors = ['rgba(57,170,255,', 'rgba(255,100,100,'];

        sims.forEach((sim, idx) => {
            const color = colors[idx];
            sim.profile.day_by_day.forEach(dayData => {
                const displayDay = dayData.day + sim.offset;
                if (displayDay < minD || displayDay > maxD) return;

                const effective = getEffectiveDayData(sim, dayData.day);
                if (!effective) return;

                const x = mapX(displayDay);
                const val = metric === 'temp' ? effective.shell_temp : effective.humidity_set;
                const tol = getTolerance(effective.sensitivity, metric);
                const yLow = mapY(val - tol);
                const yHigh = mapY(val + tol);
                const alpha = effective.sensitivity === 'CRITICAL' ? '0.35)' : effective.sensitivity === 'HIGH' ? '0.2)' : '0.12)';

                ctx.fillStyle = color + alpha;
                ctx.fillRect(x - 2, yHigh, 4, yLow - yHigh);

                ctx.strokeStyle = color + '0.9)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                ctx.beginPath();
                const yIdeal = mapY(val);
                ctx.moveTo(x - 2, yIdeal);
                ctx.lineTo(x + 2, yIdeal);
                ctx.stroke();
            });
        });

        const xCurrent = mapX(currentDay);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.25)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.setLineDash([2, 3]);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(xCurrent, pad.top);
        ctx.lineTo(xCurrent, pad.top + plotH);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        const d1 = getEffectiveDayData(sim1, clamp(currentDay - sim1.offset, 1, sim1.profile.incubation_days));
        const d2 = getEffectiveDayData(sim2, clamp(currentDay - sim2.offset, 1, sim2.profile.incubation_days));
        const val1 = d1 ? (metric === 'temp' ? d1.shell_temp.toFixed(2) + ' C' : d1.humidity_set + ' %') : '--';
        const val2 = d2 ? (metric === 'temp' ? d2.shell_temp.toFixed(2) + ' C' : d2.humidity_set + ' %') : '--';
        const legendEl = metric === 'temp' ? tempLegend : humLegend;
        if (legendEl) legendEl.textContent = 'SIM1: ' + val1 + ' | SIM2: ' + val2;
    }

    function updateAll(showStatus) {
        sim1.species = species1.value;
        sim2.species = species2.value;
        sim1.offset = clamp(parseInt(offset1.value, 10) || 0, 0, 10);
        sim2.offset = clamp(parseInt(offset2.value, 10) || 0, 0, 10);
        sim1.profile = getProfile(sim1.species);
        sim2.profile = getProfile(sim2.species);

        currentDay = clamp(parseInt(daySlider.value, 10) || 10, 1, 30);
        dayDisplay.textContent = currentDay;

        simConfig.scenario = scenarioSelect.value;
        simConfig.noise = clamp(Number(noiseLevel.value), 0, 0.8);
        simConfig.tempBias = clamp(Number(tempBias.value), -1.5, 1.5);
        simConfig.humBias = clamp(Number(humBias.value), -15, 15);
        setScenarioValueLabels();

        updateInfoCards();
        drawCharts();
        updateComparison();
        persistConfig();

        if (showStatus) {
            ink.setStatus('Symulacja zaktualizowana', 'ok');
        }
    }

    function exportCSV() {
        const lines = [];
        lines.push('Dzien,Gatunek1,Temp1_C,RH1_pct,Gatunek2,Temp2_C,RH2_pct,Scenariusz,Noise,TempBias,HumBias');

        const maxD = Math.max(sim1.profile.incubation_days + sim1.offset, sim2.profile.incubation_days + sim2.offset);
        for (let d = 1; d <= maxD; d++) {
            const d1 = getEffectiveDayData(sim1, clamp(d - sim1.offset, 1, sim1.profile.incubation_days));
            const d2 = getEffectiveDayData(sim2, clamp(d - sim2.offset, 1, sim2.profile.incubation_days));

            lines.push([
                d,
                sim1.profile.common_name,
                d1 ? d1.shell_temp.toFixed(2) : '--',
                d1 ? d1.humidity_set : '--',
                sim2.profile.common_name,
                d2 ? d2.shell_temp.toFixed(2) : '--',
                d2 ? d2.humidity_set : '--',
                simConfig.scenario,
                simConfig.noise.toFixed(2),
                simConfig.tempBias.toFixed(1),
                simConfig.humBias.toFixed(0)
            ].join(','));
        }

        const blob = new Blob([lines.join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = 'analiza_legow_' + Date.now() + '.csv';
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        ink.setStatus('Pobrano CSV z symulacji', 'ok');
    }

    function resetAll() {
        sim1 = { species: 'chicken', offset: 0, profile: PROFILES.chicken };
        sim2 = { species: 'duck_indian_runner', offset: 5, profile: PROFILES.duck_indian_runner };
        currentDay = 10;
        simConfig.scenario = 'normal';
        simConfig.noise = 0.15;
        simConfig.tempBias = 0;
        simConfig.humBias = 0;
        simConfig.autoRun = false;
        stopAutoRun();
        syncControlsFromState();
        updateAll(true);
    }

    function goBack() {
        window.location.href = '/';
    }

    function startAutoRun() {
        if (autoTimer) return;
        simConfig.autoRun = true;
        playBtn.textContent = 'Auto-run ON';
        autoTimer = setInterval(() => {
            const next = Number(daySlider.value) >= 30 ? 1 : Number(daySlider.value) + 1;
            daySlider.value = next;
            updateAll(false);
        }, 1200);
        persistConfig();
    }

    function stopAutoRun() {
        simConfig.autoRun = false;
        playBtn.textContent = 'Auto-run OFF';
        if (autoTimer) {
            clearInterval(autoTimer);
            autoTimer = null;
        }
        persistConfig();
    }

    function toggleAutoRun() {
        if (simConfig.autoRun) {
            stopAutoRun();
            ink.setStatus('Auto-run zatrzymany', 'info');
        } else {
            startAutoRun();
            ink.setStatus('Auto-run uruchomiony', 'ok');
        }
    }

    ink.onWsEvent(function(type) {
        if (type === 'open') {
            ink.setStatus('Polaczono', 'ok');
        }
    });

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        loadConfig();
        syncControlsFromState();

        species1.addEventListener('change', () => updateAll(true));
        species2.addEventListener('change', () => updateAll(true));
        offset1.addEventListener('change', () => updateAll(true));
        offset2.addEventListener('change', () => updateAll(true));
        scenarioSelect.addEventListener('change', () => updateAll(true));

        noiseLevel.addEventListener('input', () => updateAll(false));
        tempBias.addEventListener('input', () => updateAll(false));
        humBias.addEventListener('input', () => updateAll(false));

        daySlider.addEventListener('input', () => updateAll(false));

        if (updateBtn) updateBtn.addEventListener('click', () => updateAll(true));
        if (exportBtn) exportBtn.addEventListener('click', exportCSV);
        if (resetBtn) resetBtn.addEventListener('click', resetAll);
        if (backBtn) backBtn.addEventListener('click', goBack);
        if (playBtn) playBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleAutoRun);

        updateAll(false);

        if (simConfig.autoRun) {
            startAutoRun();
        }

        let resizeTimeout;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
            resizeTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                drawCharts();
            }, 200);
        });

        console.log('[symulacja_legow.js] Zainicjalizowano');
    });
})();

```

$cp1250 = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(1250)
$utf8 = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8

$raw = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $path
$lines = $raw -split "`r?`n"

}

```
Index status panel hardening (inkubator-new/firmware/data/index.html)

- Avoid synthetic random fallback readings when API fetch fails; keep last valid sample and show offline state.
- Guard optional canvases (`balanceCanvas`, `trendCanvas`) before `getContext` and resize/draw calls.
- Add on-page legend clarifying deviation-map dots (X=RH delta, Y=Temp delta, color severity).

//  UZUPEŁNIENIE HUD – wiązanie elementów z danymi
// ============================================================

// Nadpisanie updateHUD aby obsługiwało wszystkie elementy
const originalUpdateHUD = updateHUD;
updateHUD = function() {
    if (!statusData) return;
    const setpoint = getSetpointsFromTrays();
    const avgTemp = statusData.temp_chamber ?? 0;
    const rh = statusData.humidity ?? 0;
    const ds1 = statusData.temp_chamber ?? 0;
    const ds2 = statusData.temp_aquarium ?? 0;
    const setTemp = setpoint.tempAvg || statusData.target_temp || 37.7;
    const setRh = setpoint.rhAvg || statusData.target_humidity || 60.0;
    const tDev = avgTemp - setTemp;
    const rDev = rh - setRh;

    setText('ds1Val', (isFinite(ds1) ? ds1.toFixed(2) : '--') + ' °C');
    setText('ds2Val', (isFinite(ds2) ? ds2.toFixed(2) : '--') + ' °C');
    setText('avgVal', (isFinite(avgTemp) ? avgTemp.toFixed(2) : '--') + ' °C');
    setText('rhVal', (isFinite(rh) ? rh.toFixed(1) : '--') + ' %');

    const tDevStr = isFinite(tDev) ? (tDev &gt;= 0 ? '+' : '') + tDev.toFixed(2) : '--';
    const rDevStr = isFinite(rDev) ? (rDev &gt;= 0 ? '+' : '') + rDev.toFixed(1) : '--';
    setText('dtVal', tDevStr + ' °C');
    setText('drVal', rDevStr + ' %');

    const fmt = (v) =&gt; (v !== null &amp;&amp; isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(2) : '--');
    const fmtRh = (v) =&gt; (v !== null &amp;&amp; isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(1) : '--');
    setText('setT1Display', fmt(setpoint.temp1) + ' °C');
    setText('setT2Display', fmt(setpoint.temp2) + ' °C');
    setText('setTAvgDisplay', fmt(setpoint.tempAvg) + ' °C');
    setText('setRh1Display', fmtRh(setpoint.rh1) + ' %');
    setText('setRh2Display', fmtRh(setpoint.rh2) + ' %');
    setText('setRhAvgDisplay', fmtRh(setpoint.rhAvg) + ' %');

    const tAlarm = isFinite(tDev) &amp;&amp; Math.abs(tDev) &gt; 1.5;
    const tWarn = isFinite(tDev) &amp;&amp; Math.abs(tDev) &gt; 0.3 &amp;&amp; !tAlarm;
    const rAlarm = isFinite(rDev) &amp;&amp; Math.abs(rDev) &gt; 8.0;
    const rWarn = isFinite(rDev) &amp;&amp; Math.abs(rDev) &gt; 3.0 &amp;&amp; !rAlarm;
    document.getElementById('avgRow').className = 'hud-row' + (tAlarm ? ' alarm' : tWarn ? ' warn' : '');
    document.getElementById('dtRow').className = 'hud-row' + (tAlarm ? ' alarm' : tWarn ? ' warn' : '');
    document.getElementById('rhRow').className = 'hud-row' + (rAlarm ? ' alarm' : rWarn ? ' warn' : '');
    document.getElementById('drRow').className = 'hud-row' + (rAlarm ? ' alarm' : rWarn ? ' warn' : '');

    const pwm0 = statusData.heater_pwm_ch0 ?? 0;
    const pwm1 = statusData.heater_pwm_ch1 ?? 0;
    const pct0 = Math.min(100, (pwm0 / 4095) * 100);
    const pct1 = Math.min(100, (pwm1 / 4095) * 100);
    document.getElementById('heaterFill0').style.width = pct0 + '%';
    document.getElementById('heaterFill1').style.width = pct1 + '%';
    document.getElementById('heaterVal0').textContent = Math.round(pct0) + '%';
    document.getElementById('heaterVal1').textContent = Math.round(pct1) + '%';

    const diffOn = statusData.diffuser_0_on || statusData.diffuser_on || false;
    const led = document.getElementById('diffuserLed');
    if (led) led.className = 'led' + (diffOn ? ' on' : '');
};Kluczowe zmiany:Dodano sekcję center-panel z canvas dla elipsy i HUD-amiDodano sekcję trend-panel z canvas dla wykresu trenduDodano suwaki (sliders-panel) dla wizualizacji PWMDodano liniały tac (trays-panel) dla wizualizacji postępuRozszerzono updateHUD o obsługę wszystkich nowych elementówTeraz panel powinien wyglądać jak profesjonalny dashboard z pełną wizualizacją danych!

+        function generateProfile(speciesId, day, offset = 0, noise = 0.15, tempBias = 0, humBias = 0, scenario = 'normal') {
+            const info = SPECIES_DATA[speciesId] || SPECIES_DATA.chicken;
+            const totalDays = info.days;
+            const effectiveDay = Math.min(day + offset, totalDays);

+            // Bazowe wartości
+            let temp = 37.8;

+            let turning = true;

+            if (effectiveDay >= info.lockdown) {
+                temp = 37.2;
+                rh = 70;
+                lockdown = true;
+                turning = false;
+                sensitivity = 'HIGH';
+            } else if (effectiveDay > totalDays * 0.7) {
+                temp = 37.8 + (effectiveDay - totalDays * 0.7) / totalDays * 0.3;
+                rh = 55 + (effectiveDay - totalDays * 0.7) / totalDays * 10;
+                sensitivity = 'CRITICAL';
+            } else if (effectiveDay < 4) {
+                sensitivity = 'CRITICAL';
+            } else if (effectiveDay < 7) {
+                sensitivity = 'HIGH';

+
+            // Scenariusze
+            switch (scenario) {
+                case 'heat_stress':
+                    temp += 2.0 + Math.random() * 0.5;
+                    break;
+                case 'cold_stress':
+                    temp -= 2.0 + Math.random() * 0.5;
+                    break;
+                case 'dry':
+                    rh -= 15 + Math.random() * 5;
+                    break;
+                case 'wet':
+                    rh += 15 + Math.random() * 5;
+                    break;
+            }
+
+            // Szum i bias
+            temp += (Math.random() - 0.5) * noise * 2 + tempBias;
+            rh += (Math.random() - 0.5) * noise * 6 + humBias;
+
+            // Ograniczenia
+            temp = Math.max(35, Math.min(42, temp));
+            rh = Math.max(20, Math.min(95, rh));
+
+            return {

+            // Określenie zakresu
+            const allValues = [...data1, ...data2].filter(v => isFinite(v));
+            let min = yMin !== undefined ? yMin : Math.min(...allValues) - 0.3;
+            let max = yMax !== undefined ? yMax : Math.max(...allValues) + 0.3;
+            if (max - min < 1) { min -= 0.5; max += 0.5; }
+
+            const mapX = (idx, len) => pad.left + (idx / (len - 1 || 1)) * plotW;
+            const mapY = (v) => pad.top + plotH - ((v - min) / (max - min)) * plotH;
+
+            // Tło
+            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,12,14,0.3)';
+            ctx.fillRect(pad.left, pad.top, plotW, plotH);
