<script src="js/common.js"></script>
<script>
(function() {
    'use strict';

    // ============================================================
    //  DANE SYMULACYJNE
    // ============================================================
    const SPECIES_DATA = {
        chicken: { name: 'Kura', days: 21, lockdown: 19 },
        duck_indian_runner: { name: 'Kaczka Biegus', days: 28, lockdown: 25 },
        goose: { name: 'Gęś', days: 30, lockdown: 27 },
        quail: { name: 'Przepiórka', days: 17, lockdown: 15 }
    };

    // ============================================================
    //  GENEROWANIE DANYCH SYMULACYJNYCH
    // ============================================================
    function generateProfile(speciesId, day, offset = 0, noise = 0.15, tempBias = 0, humBias = 0, scenario = 'normal') {
        const info = SPECIES_DATA[speciesId] || SPECIES_DATA.chicken;
        const totalDays = info.days;
        const effectiveDay = Math.min(day + offset, totalDays);
        
        // Bazowe wartości
        let temp = 37.8;
        let rh = 55;
        let sensitivity = 'MEDIUM';
        let turning = true;
        let lockdown = false;

        // Fazy inkubacji
        if (effectiveDay >= info.lockdown) {
            temp = 37.2;
            rh = 70;
            lockdown = true;
            turning = false;
            sensitivity = 'HIGH';
        } else if (effectiveDay > totalDays * 0.7) {
            temp = 37.8 + (effectiveDay - totalDays * 0.7) / totalDays * 0.3;
            rh = 55 + (effectiveDay - totalDays * 0.7) / totalDays * 10;
            sensitivity = 'CRITICAL';
        } else if (effectiveDay < 4) {
            sensitivity = 'CRITICAL';
        } else if (effectiveDay < 7) {
            sensitivity = 'HIGH';
        }

        // Scenariusze
        switch (scenario) {
            case 'heat_stress':
                temp += 2.0 + Math.random() * 0.5;
                break;
            case 'cold_stress':
                temp -= 2.0 + Math.random() * 0.5;
                break;
            case 'dry':
                rh -= 15 + Math.random() * 5;
                break;
            case 'wet':
                rh += 15 + Math.random() * 5;
                break;
        }

        // Szum i bias
        temp += (Math.random() - 0.5) * noise * 2 + tempBias;
        rh += (Math.random() - 0.5) * noise * 6 + humBias;
        
        // Ograniczenia
        temp = Math.max(35, Math.min(42, temp));
        rh = Math.max(20, Math.min(95, rh));

        return {
            day: effectiveDay,
            totalDays,
            temp: Math.round(temp * 100) / 100,
            rh: Math.round(rh * 10) / 10,
            sensitivity,
            turning,
            lockdown,
            isLockdown: lockdown,
            species: info.name
        };
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  RYSOWANIE WYKRESÓW
    // ============================================================
    function drawChart(canvasId, data1, data2, metric, yMin, yMax) {
        const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
        if (!canvas) return;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const rect = canvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        const w = rect.width - 20;
        const h = canvas.parentElement.clientHeight - 30 || 200;
        
        canvas.width = w * dpr;
        canvas.height = h * dpr;
        canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

        if (!data1 || data1.length < 2) {
            ctx.fillStyle = '#3a424a';
            ctx.font = '12px monospace';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillText('oczekiwanie na dane...', w / 2, h / 2);
            return;
        }

        const pad = { top: 8, bottom: 8, left: 28, right: 8 };
        const plotW = w - pad.left - pad.right;
        const plotH = h - pad.top - pad.bottom;

        // Określenie zakresu
        const allValues = [...data1, ...data2].filter(v => isFinite(v));
        let min = yMin !== undefined ? yMin : Math.min(...allValues) - 0.3;
        let max = yMax !== undefined ? yMax : Math.max(...allValues) + 0.3;
        if (max - min < 1) { min -= 0.5; max += 0.5; }

        const mapX = (idx, len) => pad.left + (idx / (len - 1 || 1)) * plotW;
        const mapY = (v) => pad.top + plotH - ((v - min) / (max - min)) * plotH;

        // Tło
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,12,14,0.3)';
        ctx.fillRect(pad.left, pad.top, plotW, plotH);

        // Siatka
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(42,50,64,0.3)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const y = pad.top + (i / 4) * plotH;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(pad.left, y);
            ctx.lineTo(pad.left + plotW, y);
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Rysowanie linii dla data1
        if (data1.length > 1) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#4ab0ff';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.beginPath();
            data1.forEach((v, i) => {
                const x = mapX(i, data1.length);
                const y = mapY(v);
                if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            });
            ctx.stroke();

            // Ostatni punkt
            const last = data1[data1.length - 1];
            if (isFinite(last)) {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#4ab0ff';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(mapX(data1.length - 1, data1.length), mapY(last), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        // Rysowanie linii dla data2
        if (data2.length > 1) {
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff6a6a';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.beginPath();
            data2.forEach((v, i) => {
                const x = mapX(i, data2.length);
                const y = mapY(v);
                if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            });
            ctx.stroke();

            const last = data2[data2.length - 1];
            if (isFinite(last)) {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6a6a';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(mapX(data2.length - 1, data2.length), mapY(last), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
        }

        // Legenda na wykresie
        ctx.font = '7px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4ab0ff';
        ctx.fillText('SIM1', pad.left + 4, pad.top + plotH - 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6a6a';
        ctx.fillText('SIM2', pad.left + 34, pad.top + plotH - 4);

        // Etykiety osi Y
        ctx.fillStyle = '#5a6a7a';
        ctx.font = '7px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'right';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        const yLabels = [min, (min + max) / 2, max];
        yLabels.forEach(v => {
            ctx.fillText(v.toFixed(1), pad.left - 4, mapY(v));
        });
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  GŁÓWNA LOGIKA SYMULACJI
    // ============================================================
    let tempData1 = [], tempData2 = [];
    let humData1 = [], humData2 = [];
    let autoRun = false;
    let autoRunTimer = null;
    let currentDay = 10;

    // Generowanie danych
    function generateAllData(day) {
        const species1 = document.getElementById('species1').value;
        const species2 = document.getElementById('species2').value;
        const offset1 = parseInt(document.getElementById('offset1').value) || 0;
        const offset2 = parseInt(document.getElementById('offset2').value) || 0;
        const noise = parseFloat(document.getElementById('noiseLevel').value) || 0.15;
        const tempBias = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tempBias').value) || 0;
        const humBias = parseFloat(document.getElementById('humBias').value) || 0;
        const scenario = document.getElementById('scenarioSelect').value;

        const day1 = Math.max(1, Math.min(day + offset1, 30));
        const day2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(day + offset2, 30));

        const profile1 = generateProfile(species1, day1, 0, noise, tempBias, humBias, scenario);
        const profile2 = generateProfile(species2, day2, 0, noise, tempBias, humBias, scenario);

        // Historia
        const steps = 20;
        tempData1 = [];
        tempData2 = [];
        humData1 = [];
        humData2 = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            const progress = i / steps;
            const d1 = Math.max(1, Math.min(day1 - 5 + progress * 10, 30));
            const d2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(day2 - 5 + progress * 10, 30));
            const p1 = generateProfile(species1, d1, 0, noise * 0.5, tempBias, humBias, scenario);
            const p2 = generateProfile(species2, d2, 0, noise * 0.5, tempBias, humBias, scenario);
            tempData1.push(p1.temp);
            tempData2.push(p2.temp);
            humData1.push(p1.rh);
            humData2.push(p2.rh);
        }

        return { profile1, profile2 };
    }

    function updateDisplay(day) {
        const data = generateAllData(day);
        const p1 = data.profile1;
        const p2 = data.profile2;

        // Update info cards
        document.getElementById('info1Name').textContent = p1.species;
        document.getElementById('info1Day').textContent = p1.day + '/' + p1.totalDays;
        document.getElementById('info1Temp').textContent = p1.temp.toFixed(1) + ' °C';
        document.getElementById('info1TempRange').textContent = (p1.temp - 0.3).toFixed(1) + ' – ' + (p1.temp + 0.3).toFixed(1) + ' °C';
        document.getElementById('info1Hum').textContent = p1.rh.toFixed(0) + ' %';
        document.getElementById('info1HumRange').textContent = (p1.rh - 5).toFixed(0) + ' – ' + (p1.rh + 5).toFixed(0) + ' %';
        document.getElementById('info1Sens').textContent = p1.sensitivity;
        document.getElementById('info1Turn').textContent = p1.turning ? 'TAK' : 'NIE';

        document.getElementById('info2Name').textContent = p2.species;
        document.getElementById('info2Day').textContent = p2.day + '/' + p2.totalDays;
        document.getElementById('info2Temp').textContent = p2.temp.toFixed(1) + ' °C';
        document.getElementById('info2TempRange').textContent = (p2.temp - 0.3).toFixed(1) + ' – ' + (p2.temp + 0.3).toFixed(1) + ' °C';
        document.getElementById('info2Hum').textContent = p2.rh.toFixed(0) + ' %';
        document.getElementById('info2HumRange').textContent = (p2.rh - 5).toFixed(0) + ' – ' + (p2.rh + 5).toFixed(0) + ' %';
        document.getElementById('info2Sens').textContent = p2.sensitivity;
        document.getElementById('info2Turn').textContent = p2.turning ? 'TAK' : 'NIE';

        // Alarmy
        const alarm1 = document.getElementById('alarm1');
        const alarm2 = document.getElementById('alarm2');
        if (p1.sensitivity === 'CRITICAL' || p1.temp > 39.5 || p1.temp < 36.5) {
            alarm1.textContent = '⚠️ UWAGA! Krytyczna faza!';
            alarm1.className = 'alarm-box err';
        } else if (p1.sensitivity === 'HIGH' || p1.temp > 38.5 || p1.temp < 37.0) {
            alarm1.textContent = '⚠️ Uwaga! Wrażliwa faza';
            alarm1.className = 'alarm-box warning';
        } else {
            alarm1.textContent = '✅ OK';
            alarm1.className = 'alarm-box ok';
        }

        if (p2.sensitivity === 'CRITICAL' || p2.temp > 39.5 || p2.temp < 36.5) {
            alarm2.textContent = '⚠️ UWAGA! Krytyczna faza!';
            alarm2.className = 'alarm-box err';
        } else if (p2.sensitivity === 'HIGH' || p2.temp > 38.5 || p2.temp < 37.0) {
            alarm2.textContent = '⚠️ Uwaga! Wrażliwa faza';
            alarm2.className = 'alarm-box warning';
        } else {
            alarm2.textContent = '✅ OK';
            alarm2.className = 'alarm-box ok';
        }

        // Kompromis
        const tempMin = Math.min(p1.temp, p2.temp) - 0.2;
        const tempMax = Math.max(p1.temp, p2.temp) + 0.2;
        const humMin = Math.min(p1.rh, p2.rh) - 3;
        const humMax = Math.max(p1.rh, p2.rh) + 3;
        document.getElementById('compTemp').textContent = tempMin.toFixed(1) + ' °C do ' + tempMax.toFixed(1) + ' °C';
        document.getElementById('compHum').textContent = humMin.toFixed(0) + '% do ' + humMax.toFixed(0) + '%';
        
        const overlap = Math.max(0, Math.min(p1.temp + 0.5, p2.temp + 0.5) - Math.max(p1.temp - 0.5, p2.temp - 0.5));
        const compStatus = document.getElementById('compStatus');
        if (overlap > 0.5) {
            compStatus.textContent = '✅ Dobra kompatybilność';
            compStatus.style.color = '#70d070';
        } else if (overlap > 0.2) {
            compStatus.textContent = '⚠️ Średnia kompatybilność';
            compStatus.style.color = '#e8b830';
        } else {
            compStatus.textContent = '❌ Niska kompatybilność';
            compStatus.style.color = '#e05050';
        }

        // Legendy
        document.getElementById('tempLegend').textContent = 'SIM1: ' + p1.temp.toFixed(1) + '°C | SIM2: ' + p2.temp.toFixed(1) + '°C';
        document.getElementById('humLegend').textContent = 'SIM1: ' + p1.rh.toFixed(0) + '% | SIM2: ' + p2.rh.toFixed(0) + '%';

        // Wykresy
        drawChart('tempChart', tempData1, tempData2, 'temp');
        drawChart('humChart', humData1, humData2, 'hum');
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  EVENTY
    // ============================================================
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const daySlider = document.getElementById('daySlider');
        const dayDisplay = document.getElementById('dayDisplay');

        // Update na zmianę suwaka
        daySlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
            currentDay = parseInt(this.value);
            dayDisplay.textContent = currentDay;
            updateDisplay(currentDay);
        });

        // Przycisk odśwież
        document.getElementById('updateBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            updateDisplay(currentDay);
        });

        // Auto-run
        document.getElementById('playBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            autoRun = !autoRun;
            this.textContent = autoRun ? '⏹️ Auto-run ON' : '▶️ Auto-run OFF';
            if (autoRun) {
                autoRunTimer = setInterval(function() {
                    currentDay = (currentDay % 30) + 1;
                    daySlider.value = currentDay;
                    dayDisplay.textContent = currentDay;
                    updateDisplay(currentDay);
                }, 1200);
            } else {
                clearInterval(autoRunTimer);
            }
        });

        // Zmiana gatunku/offsetu
        document.getElementById('species1').addEventListener('change', function() { updateDisplay(currentDay); });
        document.getElementById('species2').addEventListener('change', function() { updateDisplay(currentDay); });
        document.getElementById('offset1').addEventListener('change', function() { updateDisplay(currentDay); });
        document.getElementById('offset2').addEventListener('change', function() { updateDisplay(currentDay); });
        document.getElementById('noiseLevel').addEventListener('input', function() {
            document.getElementById('noiseLevelVal').textContent = this.value;
            updateDisplay(currentDay);
        });
        document.getElementById('tempBias').addEventListener('input', function() {
            document.getElementById('tempBiasVal').textContent = parseFloat(this.value).toFixed(1) + ' °C';
            updateDisplay(currentDay);
        });
        document.getElementById('humBias').addEventListener('input', function() {
            document.getElementById('humBiasVal').textContent = parseInt(this.value) + ' %';
            updateDisplay(currentDay);
        });
        document.getElementById('scenarioSelect').addEventListener('change', function() { updateDisplay(currentDay); });

        // Wysokość wykresów
        document.getElementById('chartHeightRange').addEventListener('input', function() {
            const val = this.value;
            document.getElementById('chartHeightValue').textContent = val + ' px';
            document.querySelectorAll('.chart-box canvas').forEach(c => {
                c.style.height = val + 'px';
            });
        });

        // Zoom
        document.getElementById('expandTempBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.querySelector('.chart-container').classList.toggle('focus-temp');
        });
        document.getElementById('expandHumBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.querySelector('.chart-container').classList.toggle('focus-humidity');
        });
        document.getElementById('resetZoomBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.querySelector('.chart-container').classList.remove('focus-temp', 'focus-humidity');
        });

        // Powrót
        document.getElementById('backBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            window.location.href = 'index.html';
        });

        // Eksport
        document.getElementById('exportBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            let csv = 'day,temp1,temp2,rh1,rh2\n';
            for (let i = 0; i < tempData1.length; i++) {
                csv += i + ',' + tempData1[i] + ',' + tempData2[i] + ',' + humData1[i] + ',' + humData2[i] + '\n';
            }
            const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            link.download = 'symulacja_legow_' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace(/:/g, '-') + '.csv';
            link.click();
        });

        // Reset
        document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (confirm('Resetować symulację?')) {
                tempData1 = [];
                tempData2 = [];
                humData1 = [];
                humData2 = [];
                currentDay = 10;
                document.getElementById('daySlider').value = 10;
                document.getElementById('dayDisplay').textContent = 10;
                document.getElementById('species1').value = 'chicken';
                document.getElementById('species2').value = 'duck_indian_runner';
                document.getElementById('offset1').value = 0;
                document.getElementById('offset2').value = 5;
                document.getElementById('noiseLevel').value = 0.15;
                document.getElementById('noiseLevelVal').textContent = '0.15';
                document.getElementById('tempBias').value = 0;
                document.getElementById('tempBiasVal').textContent = '0.0 °C';
                document.getElementById('humBias').value = 0;
                document.getElementById('humBiasVal').textContent = '0 %';
                document.getElementById('scenarioSelect').value = 'normal';
                if (autoRun) {
                    autoRun = false;
                    document.getElementById('playBtn').textContent = '▶️ Auto-run OFF';
                    clearInterval(autoRunTimer);
                }
                updateDisplay(currentDay);
            }
        });

        // Initial render
        updateDisplay(currentDay);

        // Responsive - przerysuj wykresy przy zmianie rozmiaru
        let resizeTimer;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
            resizeTimer = setTimeout(function() {
                updateDisplay(currentDay);
            }, 300);
        });
    });

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
